title: Hosts by operating system
description: How many hosts run each OS and distribution, with their average CPU.
sql:
SELECT os, distro, count() AS hosts, round(avg(cpu_pct), 1) AS avg_cpu_pct
FROM hosts
GROUP BY os, distro
ORDER BY hosts DESC

title: Containers restarting the most
description: Containers with restarts, worst first, with their pod and namespace.
sql:
SELECT name, pod, namespace, cluster, restarts, status
FROM containers
WHERE restarts > 0
ORDER BY restarts DESC
LIMIT 20

title: Slowest endpoints per service
description: p95 latency of each service's server spans, slowest first.
sql:
SELECT service, name AS endpoint, count() AS requests, round(quantile(0.95)(duration_ms), 1) AS p95_ms
FROM spans
WHERE kind = 'Server'
GROUP BY service, endpoint
HAVING requests >= 10
ORDER BY p95_ms DESC
LIMIT 25

title: Error logs per service
description: Error and critical logs by service, with one example message.
sql:
SELECT service, count() AS errors, any(message) AS example
FROM logs
WHERE status IN ('error', 'critical', 'alert', 'emergency')
GROUP BY service
ORDER BY errors DESC

title: Monitors in alert by team
description: Alerting monitors grouped by the teams that own them.
sql:
SELECT arrayJoin(if(empty(teams), ['(no team)'], teams)) AS team, count() AS alerting, groupArray(name) AS monitors
FROM monitors
WHERE status = 'alert'
GROUP BY team
ORDER BY alerting DESC

title: Failed CI pipelines by repository
description: Pipeline failures and failure rate per repository.
sql:
SELECT repository, countIf(status = 'error') AS failed, count() AS runs, round(100 * failed / runs, 1) AS failure_rate_pct
FROM ci_pipelines
GROUP BY repository
ORDER BY failed DESC

title: Services by error rate
description: Requests, errors and p95 latency of each service, highest error rate first.
sql:
SELECT service, env, requests, errors, round(error_rate * 100, 2) AS error_pct, p95_ms
FROM services
ORDER BY error_rate DESC
LIMIT 20

title: Pods not running by namespace
description: Pods in any state but Running, per cluster and namespace.
sql:
SELECT cluster, namespace, status, count() AS pods
FROM k8s_pods
WHERE status != 'Running'
GROUP BY cluster, namespace, status
ORDER BY pods DESC

title: Hosts serving the most errors
description: Joins spans with hosts: error spans per host, with the host's CPU.
sql:
SELECT h.name AS host, h.os AS os, h.cpu_pct AS cpu_pct, count() AS error_spans
FROM spans AS s
INNER JOIN hosts AS h ON h.name = s.host
WHERE s.status = 'error'
GROUP BY host, os, cpu_pct
ORDER BY error_spans DESC
LIMIT 10

title: Open incidents by severity
description: Incidents not yet resolved, per severity, with the oldest declaration.
sql:
SELECT severity, count() AS open, min(declared_at) AS oldest
FROM incidents
WHERE status != 'resolved'
GROUP BY severity
ORDER BY severity
